blocks.text: Sabz cells mein roshni (light) ki maujoodgi mein hone wali tanaffusi (respiratory) sargarmi jis se carbon dioxide nikalti hai photorespiration hai. Ise oxygen chahiye aur yeh aerobic respiration ki tarah CO2 aur H2O banati hai, magar ATP nahin banta.

blocks.title: Yaad karen
blocks.text: Carbon fixation ke dauran rubisco CO2 ke teen molecules ko RuBP ke teen molecules se jor kar 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) ke chhe molecules banata hai.

RuBP carboxylase (rubisco) RuBP mein CO2 shamil karne ko catalyse karta hai jis se phosphoglyceric acid (phosphoglycerate) banta hai, jo mazeed reduce ho kar glucose banata hai. Magar jab CO2 ki nisbati concentration kam ho aur patte ke cells mein oxygen zyada ho to rubisco RuBP mein CO2 ki bajaye O2 shamil kar deta hai. Phir RuBP do molecules mein toot-ta hai, ek phosphoglycerate aur ek phosphoglycolate (do-carbon molecule).

Phosphoglycolate glycolate mein badalta hai, jo chloroplast se peroxisome mein jata hai. Wahan yeh O2 istemal kar ke glyoxylate mein metabolise hota hai, aur yeh reaction zehreela (toxic) hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) bhi banata hai. Glyoxylate glycine mein badalta hai, jo mitochondrion mein le jaya jata hai, jahan glycine ke do molecules serine ka ek molecule banate hain. Serine peroxisome mein le jaya jata hai aur glycerate mein badalta hai; glycerate chloroplast mein jata hai, jahan yeh phosphoglycerate banta hai, jo Calvin cycle mein dobara dakhil ho sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen organelles. Chloroplast mein O2 RuBP se jurti hai, jis se phosphoglycerate (G3P ban kar wapas RuBP) aur phosphoglycolate bante hain; phosphoglycolate H2O le kar aur Pi kho kar glycolate banta hai. Peroxisome mein glycolate O2 istemal kar ke aur H2O2 chhor kar glyoxylate, phir glycine banta hai. Mitochondrion mein glycine se serine banta hai. Serine peroxisome mein wapas aa kar glycerate banta hai, jo phosphoglycerate ke taur par chloroplast mein lautta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jab rubisco CO2 ki bajaye O2 pakar leta hai to RuBP ka ek hissa do-carbon phosphoglycolate ban jata hai, jise teen organelles se guzar kar wapas phosphoglycerate banana parta hai; is mein carbon (CO2) aur tawanai zaya hoti hai. Kitab ki chhapi hui figure mein chloroplast ke phosphoglycolate se glycolate wale qadam par H2O2 likha hai aur glycerate ka teer phosphoglycolate par khatam hota hai. Durust: is qadam par H2O lagta hai aur Pi nikalta hai, aur glycerate phosphoglycerate banta hai (jaisa kitab ka apna matan kehta hai). Yahan durust shakal banai gayi hai.

Jo poday carbon fix karne ke liye Calvin cycle istemal karte hain woh C-3 poday hain. Jab un mein photorespiration hoti hai to woh apne fix kiye carbon ka 25 se 50 fisad kho dete hain, jis se un ki paidawar kam hoti hai. Photorespiration ki raftar darja-hararat (temperature) par bhi munhasir hai: oonche darja-hararat par rubisco ki oxidative sargarmi us ki carbon fix karne ki sargarmi se zyada barhti hai. Garam (tropical) aab-o-hawa mein, khaas kar jahan darja-hararat aksar 28 degree Celsius se upar ho, masla sangeen hai aur zarai paidawar par bara manfi asar dalta hai.

blocks.title: Masla kaise paida hua
blocks.text: Jab photosynthesis pehli baar paida hui to hawa mein oxygen kam thi, is liye photorespiration kam ya bilkul nahin thi. Karoron saal baad azaad O2 hawa mein jama hui aur rubisco ke ek hi active site ke liye CO2 aur O2 mein muqabla shuru hua. Isi se woh masla bana jo photorespiration ab paida karti hai.
Photorespiration ke masle ke liye mawafiqat (adaptations)
Garam aab-o-hawa ke podon ne photorespiration se nimatne ke do tareeqe irtiqa kiye: C-4 photosynthesis aur CAM metabolism. C-4 aur CAM poday C-3 ke saath saath C-4 photosynthesis bhi karte hain.

Kuch poday, jin mein ghaas makai, ganna aur jowar (sorghum) aur taqreeban do darjan doosre poday groups shamil hain, aam Calvin cycle ke ilawa C-4 photosynthesis naami ek khaas rasta chalate hain. Un ke patton mein mesophyll cells mein hawa ki jagahein kam hoti hain, aur Calvin cycle ke enzymes zyada tar makhsoos bundle-sheath cells mein jama hote hain, jo CO2 ke liye na-guzar (impermeable) hain.

C-4 photosynthesis mein, mesophyll cells mein, CO2 teen-carbon molecule phosphoenol pyruvic acid se jurti hai, jis se chaar-carbon oxaloacetic acid banta hai; kyunke yeh pehli paidawar chaar carbon ki hai is amal ko C-4 photosynthesis aur podon ko C-4 poday kehte hain. Oxaloacetic acid NADH se malic acid mein badalta hai, aur malic acid saath wale bundle-sheath cell mein le jaya jata hai, jahan yeh pyruvic acid aur CO2 mein toot-ta hai. Yeh cells CO2 rok sakte hain, to us ki concentration barhti hai aur woh photorespiration ki bajaye Calvin cycle chalate hain. Pyruvic acid mesophyll cell ko wapas jata hai aur ek ATP se phir phosphoenol pyruvic acid banta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen, C-3 Photosynthesis: mesophyll cell mein CO2 RuBP ke saath Calvin cycle mein jati hai aur sugar nikalti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.22: C-3 photosynthesis aur C-4 photosynthesis (kitab ki Figure 5.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Baen, C-3 Photosynthesis: mesophyll cell mein CO2 RuBP ke saath Calvin cycle mein jati hai aur sugar nikalti hai. Daen, C-4 Photosynthesis: mesophyll cell mein CO2 phosphoenol pyruvic acid (3-C) se jur kar oxaloacetic acid (4-C) banati hai, jo malic acid (4-C) banta hai; malic acid bundle sheath cell mein ja kar CO2 aur pyruvic acid (3-C) mein toot-ta hai; CO2 RuBP ke saath Calvin cycle mein ja kar sugar banati hai, aur pyruvic acid mesophyll cell mein wapas ja kar dobara phosphoenol pyruvic acid banta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: C-3 poday mein rubisco seedha hawa wali CO2 pakarta hai, is liye garmi mein O2 bhi pakar leta hai. C-4 poday mein mesophyll cell pehle CO2 ko chaar-carbon acid mein band karta hai aur bundle sheath cell mein chhorta hai, jahan CO2 bohat zyada ho jati hai. Wahan rubisco sirf CO2 pakarta hai aur photorespiration taqreeban nahin hoti.

blocks.title: C-4 ki qeemat
blocks.text: C-4 photosynthesis mein ek glucose molecule banane ki tawanai ki qeemat taqreeban dugni hai. Magar garam aab-o-hawa mein, jahan photorespiration warna fix kiye carbon ka aadhe se zyada le jati, yeh dastiyab behtareen samjhota hai.

Garam aab-o-hawa mein bohat se rasdar (succulent) poday jaise cacti, ananas (pineapple) aur kuch doosre poday groups crassulacean acid metabolism, ya CAM, karte hain, jis ka naam us poday khandan Crassulaceae par hai jis mein yeh pehli baar daryaft hua. In podon mein stomata raat ko khulte aur din mein band hote hain. Din mein stomata band rakhna pani ke zaya aur CO2 ke nikalne ko rokta hai, to carbon dioxide ki oonchi concentration se photorespiration ki raftar kam hoti hai. Sugar banane ke liye zaroori carbon dioxide pichhli raat bane organic molecules se milti hai. C-4 podon ki tarah yeh poday C-4 aur C-3 dono raste istemal karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Garam dopahar mein photorespiration bad-tar kyun ho jati hai, aur makai aur cacti har ek is se kaise bachte hain?
blocks.explanation: Oonche darja-hararat par rubisco ki oxidative sargarmi us ki carbon fix karne ki sargarmi se tez barhti hai, aur pani bachane ke liye stomata band hote hain to CO2 girti aur O2 jama hoti hai; rubisco phir RuBP mein O2 shamil karta hai. Makai, ek C-4 poda, mesophyll mein CO2 ko PEP par fix karta hai aur use malic acid ke taur par bundle-sheath cells tak pohanchata hai, jahan oonchi CO2 rubisco ko Calvin cycle par rakhti hai. Cacti, CAM poday, apne stomata sirf raat ko kholte hain, CO2 organic acids mein zakheera karte hain, aur din mein band stomata ke peeche use Calvin cycle ko dete hain.

items: Photorespiration: roshni mein, zyada O2 aur kam CO2 par, rubisco RuBP mein O2 shamil karta hai, jis se phosphoglycerate aur phosphoglycolate bante hain; glycolate ka rasta peroxisome (H2O2) aur mitochondrion (do glycine se serine, CO2 nikalti hai) se ho kar glycerate chloroplast ko wapas karta hai. O2 kharch, CO2 nikalti hai, ATP nahin.
C-3 poday fix kiye carbon ka 25 se 50 fisad khote hain, 28 degree Celsius se upar bad-tar; masla tab paida hua jab hawa ki O2 jama ho kar rubisco ke active site ke liye CO2 se muqabla karne lagi.

C-4 poday (makai, ganna, jowar) mesophyll mein CO2 ko PEP par fix karte hain (oxaloacetic se malic acid) aur CO2 na-guzar bundle-sheath cells mein use Calvin cycle ke liye chhorte hain, taqreeban dugni tawanai ki qeemat par. CAM poday (cacti, ananas) raat ko stomata kholte hain, CO2 organic acids mein zakheera karte hain aur din mein istemal karte hain.
